t: Post planning and multi-channel prep studio
Plan and manage posts across multiple channels in one session: draft editor, character counters, templates, timeline, and ICS export.

Quick answer: Write a single draft, then generate ready versions for each platform with a character counter, templates, hashtags, and a visual preview, arrange publishing on a local timeline, adjust timing by time zone, and export a JSON package or ICS file with no connection or permanent storage. Everything runs in the browser, and you can save the session as a JSON file and import it later. Buttons are clear, empty states are handled, and nothing is saved permanently: export and import your files whenever you like, check the counters before publishing, drag to reorder, and export quickly with one click.
How do I copy a single platform draft?
Choose the platform, review the text in the ready platform copy box, then click Copy platform draft.
Can timing be adjusted by time zone?
Yes, choose a time zone from the list and the time display and export will update.
Drag an item in the timeline or use the up and down buttons.
How do I save the session without browser storage?
Export the JSON package, then import it later from a file.
What does the ICS file contain?
It contains publishing events with times, titles, and descriptions.
